Rule, written before any candidate commit exists. For each target, on its commit (the subject tied with hyp subject before the run): (1) each skills/*/SKILL.md the commit changes against 7825275 passes ak-skill-creator's quick_validate.py (sha256 d81f883a9ddbb87fa2b015781e42041811cb14750dd3a703cfaeca409c1d7247) with exit 0 and 'Skill is valid!', run as uv run --with PyYAML==6.0.3 python quick_validate.py skills/<name>; (2) lint_cruft.py --routing (sha256 ff36baefb5aa720b3e74a4c3f71df3cdb1c88d320e8296f25ce1b961660a0946) on that SKILL.md reports high=0; (3) go vet ./... and go test ./... -count=1 pass, which runs skillcheck (internal/skillcheck). For H-AAHHZ1 (raise-budget), which changes code, also: TestPromptPrintsTheGoalsRunPrompt from the candidate fails on 7825275's code (red: it prints 5 Results where the test wants 7) and passes on the candidate (green); and the removal check: with prompt.go's default set back to 5 on the candidate, that test fails. Supports a target when every part holds, else contradicts. A part a commit gives no input to (no SKILL.md changed) holds. The base skills at 7825275 pass (1) and (2) for hyp-goal-run and hyp-owner-grill, checked before this Experiment. The candidates are compiled to separate paths under the sandbox scratch, never over an installed hyp. Logs go under .tree/evidence/<this E>/.
